verdict.summary: A multi-tenant Xero agent can begin self-service with an OAuth Web/Auth Code or PKCE app, but the Starter tier is limited to five connections. A typical commercial agent that needs more connections, hosted Remote MCP, or App Store distribution must move to paid tiers; certification and App Store review introduce provider gates. OAuth production through the developer's own sales channel does not itself require an App Store listing.
verdict.activeEffort: No published implementation-time estimate; required work includes secure OAuth lifecycle handling, connection-management UX, agent safety controls, and certification materials.
verdict.waitTime: Unknown: Xero publishes no fixed certification or App Store review turnaround, and no dependable numeric community timeframe is available. App Store review also requires Sign Up with Xero and ten active customer connections before submission.
verdict.mainGate: Starter permits five connections; commercial scale requires a paid tier, while App Store listing requires Plus or above, certification compliance, and ten active customer connections.

recommendation.text: Build an OAuth Web/Auth Code app when the agent backend can protect the client secret; use PKCE only when a native or agent-client initiates authorization and cannot safely retain a secret. Use per-user OAuth connections for each customer tenant, not Custom Connections, and choose direct distribution unless App Store discovery is a business requirement.

essentials.text: Request offline_access for a long-lived agent connection. Access tokens are valid for up to 30 minutes and refresh tokens for up to 60 days; refresh rotates both tokens, so encrypt them server-side and atomically replace the stored pair. A stale refresh token is retryable for only 30 minutes before the user must reconnect.

You must save both tokens in order to maintain API access.

steps.output:
Reviewer test instructions
1. Sign in and choose Connect Xero.
2. Complete Xero OAuth; select the intended organisation.
3. Open Settings > Xero Connections to verify tenant name and status.
4. Run a read-only query.
5. Start a write action; verify the proposed values and account mapping, then confirm before submission.
6. Disconnect from Settings and verify the tenant is removed.
7. Reconnect and verify the status returns to Connected.
Security note: tokens are server-side only; Xero data is not used to train or fine-tune models.
